header: Using service-linked roles to create OpenSearch Ingestion pipelines
content:
Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion uses AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) service-linked
roles. A service-linked role is a unique type of IAM role that is linked directly to OpenSearch
Ingestion. Service-linked roles are predeﬁned by OpenSearch Ingestion and include all the
permissions that the service requires to call other AWS services on your behalf.
OpenSearch Ingestion uses the service-linked role named
AWSServiceRoleForAmazonOpenSearchIngestionService, except when you
use a self-managed VPC, in which case it uses the service-linked role named
AWSServiceRoleForOpensearchIngestionSelfManagedVpce. The attached policy provides the
permissions necessary for the role to create a virtual private cloud (VPC) between your account and
OpenSearch Ingestion, and to publish CloudWatch metrics to your account.
